description: Java class defining an event 'ThingsOutOfSync' used to report out-of-sync items in a search index within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances, JSON serialization/deserialization, and metadata.

classes.name: ThingsOutOfSync
classes.description: An immutable event class used to indicate that certain 'things' are out of sync in the search index, with JSON serialization/deserialization and metadata handling.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ThingsOutOfSync instance with specified thing IDs and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ThingsOutOfSync instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: getThingIds
methods.description: Returns the collection of thing IDs associated with this event.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the Ditto headers associated with this event.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the resource path, which is empty for this event.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on thing IDs and headers.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on thing IDs and headers.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the event.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns the same instance, as the event has no revision.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional, as the event has no timestamp.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional for metadata.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the event to JSON, including type and thing IDs.
